```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
picks <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "picks")
roster <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "roster")
coaches <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "coaches")
# Both rules name the same coaches only when the sets match exactly. Classes
# before the window are kept, in grey, to show they agree by construction.
first_class <- 2011L
window_from <- 2014L
window_label <- paste0(window_from, " classes on")
links_last <- coach_draftee_links(picks, roster, coaches, "last", first_class)
links_any <- coach_draftee_links(picks, roster, coaches, "any", first_class)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Each pick is one draftee; the two rules are compared as exact coach sets.
keys <- distinct(links_last, year, overall)
sets_last <- split(links_last$coach_id, paste(links_last$year, links_last$overall))
sets_any <- split(links_any$coach_id, paste(links_any$year, links_any$overall))
jaccard <- function(a, b) length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
overlap <- keys |>
  mutate(
    jacc = vapply(
      paste(year, overall),
      \(k) jaccard(sets_last[[k]], sets_any[[k]]),
      numeric(1)
    )
  )
# Share of draftees whose seasons span more than one school.
reused <- reused_ids(roster)
multi_school <- picks |>
  filter(!is.na(playerId), year >= first_class, !playerId %in% reused) |>
  distinct(playerId, year, overall) |>
  inner_join(distinct(roster, playerId, season, team), by = "playerId", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  filter(season < year) |>
  group_by(year, overall) |>
  summarise(teams_played = n_distinct(team), .groups = "drop")
by_class <- overlap |>
  left_join(multi_school, by = c("year", "overall")) |>
  mutate(transferred = teams_played > 1) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    same_set = mean(jacc == 1),
    multi_school = mean(transferred, na.rm = TRUE),
    picks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(in_window = year >= window_from)
window_mean <- mean(by_class$same_set[by_class$in_window])

p <- ggplot(by_class, aes(year, same_set)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = window_mean, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#374151", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(by_class, in_window),
    colour = "#374151",
    linewidth = 1.6
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      colour = in_window,
      tooltip = sprintf("Draft class %d: %.0f%% of %s picks", year, 100 * same_set, fmt(picks)),
      data_id = year
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#D1D5DB", `TRUE` = "#374151"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(by_class$year), max(by_class$year), 3)) +
  labs(
    title = "Picks whose coaches match under both rules",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Last-school and every-season rules name the same coaches; ",
      window_label,
      ", dashed line is the window average"
    ),
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "Share of picks",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "coach-counting-rules", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-transfer
p_tr <- ggplot(by_class, aes(100 * multi_school, 100 * same_set)) +
  geom_path(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      colour = year,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "Draft class %d: %.0f%% of draftees played for more than one school; %.0f%% of %s picks name the same coaches",
        year, 100 * multi_school, 100 * same_set, fmt(picks)
      ),
      data_id = year
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "#9CA3AF", high = "#374151", guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "More multi-school draftees, less agreement between the rules",
    subtitle = "Each point is a draft class; darker points are later classes",
    x = "Draftees who played for more than one school",
    y = "Picks naming the same coaches",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_tr, width_svg = 11, height_svg = 6)
```
